title: THE ULTIMATE CAMP SETUP -- How We Make ANYWHERE Feel Like Home
description:
We live on the road in our van, so one of the most important things is making sure that ANYWHERE feels like home. But we also don't want to carry around a bunch of stuff we don't use, so over time we've settled on a pretty good camp setup that balances comfort, convenience and portability. We also cook all our own meals so we have our mobile kitchen setup pretty dialed!

Here are links to the things we mentioned in the video as well as a couple of discount codes for you guys!
